topic: Inflation: why the same money buys less over time, and why savings left as cash slowly lose value.

episode.title: Why the Same Money Buys Less

shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, bright 3D cafe counter, one bread roll beside a small pile of coins, no text or signs.
shots.action: Kash holds up two fingers beside the single bread roll.
shots.mood: Puzzled expression, raised eyebrows, warm peach lighting.

shots.narration: Coin explains: inflation means prices rise over time.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, clean 3D cafe table, bread roll beside a staircase of progressively taller coin piles, no text.
shots.action: Coin points along the rising coin piles.
shots.mood: Friendly teaching moment, bright gold and turquoise colours.

shots.narration: [surprised] For example, ten coins once bought two snacks.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, softly glowing illustrative cafe tabletop, ten plain coins opposite two matching bread rolls, no markings or text.
shots.action: Coin slides the ten coins toward the two bread rolls.
shots.mood: Clear and cheerful, warm nostalgic glow.

shots.narration: Later, those same snacks might cost ten coins each.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, same illustrative cafe tabletop, two matching bread rolls each beside a separate pile of ten plain coins, no text.
shots.action: Coin points to one bread roll and its coin pile.

shots.narration: Now Kash's ten coins buy just one snack.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, bright cafe counter, ten plain coins opposite one bread roll, no text or signs.
shots.action: Kash pulls the single bread roll toward herself.
shots.mood: Small disappointment, soft daylight, uncluttered composition.

shots.narration: [sighs] Her cash stayed the same; its buying power shrank.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, modern apartment table, unchanged transparent jar containing ten plain coins beside two bread rolls, no text.
shots.action: Coin slides one bread roll away from the jar.
shots.mood: Gentle realization, clear visual contrast, friendly colours.

shots.narration: Cash savings can lose buying power as prices rise.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, modern apartment table, cash jar beside a rising staircase of coin piles and one bread roll, no text.
shots.action: Coin gestures from the cash jar toward the rising piles.
shots.mood: Calm explanation, warm gold highlights, attentive expression.

shots.narration: The key question: what can your money still buy?
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, clean apartment table, transparent cash jar and single bread roll, no text.
shots.action: Kash holds the cash jar beside the bread roll.
shots.mood: Thoughtful understanding, relaxed smile, bright natural light.

shots.narration: [excited] Check one everyday price today; next, let's explore budgeting!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, bright cafe table, bread roll, plain coins and an open notebook containing only a bread-roll drawing, no letters or numbers.
shots.action: Kash points to the bread roll beside her open notebook.
shots.mood: Practical and upbeat, cheerful smiles, sunny yellow accents.

episode.endHook: Next episode: how a simple budget helps organize your money.
episode.description: Coin helps Kash discover how inflation can shrink what cash savings buy. Simple example numbers show the difference between keeping the same money and keeping the same buying power.
